skills_versions: To achieve this certification, you must hold NSE 4 FortiOS certification, NSE 5 or NSE 6 certification, and NSE 7 certification, in the same track as the NSE 5 or NSE 6, and pass the proctored OT Security Architect exam within 2 years of the last prerequisite exam.
The awarded certification will be active for 2 years from the date of the Industry Certification in OT Security exam, or the last prerequisite exam, whichever is later.
Click the exam name for more details.
Fortinet NSE I - OT Security Architect
We recommend taking the associated NSE courses to prepare for the certification exam.
